summary: Synopsys filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 announcing a $1 billion accelerated share repurchase agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association. Synopsys received an initial delivery of roughly 1,735,000 shares, with any remainder settling on or before January 5, 2027. The final share count depends on daily volume-weighted average prices during the repurchase period, less a discount. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The ASR reduces shares outstanding and signals capital-return conviction; watch for completion, actual repurchase price, and any buyback-program capacity updates.
